verification_status: Static R1/R2/R3 contract tests passed 18/18 and production frontend build passed. Live database fixture and multi-account deployment QA are pending Supabase restoration from a paused state.

checks.requirement_or_scenario: R3-01 through R3-05 mutual faculty-student match
checks.method_or_action: Verified faculty proposes a match naming two students; each student independently confirms or declines.
checks.role: verified faculty, invited student one, invited student two
checks.setup: Load the R3 fixture and use two distinct student fixture profiles. Use a controlled/reset fixture copy for stateful scenarios.
checks.expected_behavior: A proposal becomes partly confirmed after the first confirmation and confirmed only after every named student confirms. Invited participants see the proposal and response state; neither faculty nor an uninvolved student can confirm on another person's behalf.

checks.requirement_or_scenario: R3-04 and R3-07 decline, withdrawal, and partner agreement
checks.method_or_action: An invited student declines one proposal; the proposing faculty member withdraws another; faculty records partner agreement in principle for an industry opportunity.
checks.role: invited student and proposing verified faculty
checks.setup: Create separate test proposals so a decline and withdrawal do not overwrite the baseline fixture state.
checks.expected_behavior: The opportunity and match records remain; declined and withdrawn are distinct. Partner agreement is a faculty-recorded statement, not a partner login or public contact disclosure.

checks.requirement_or_scenario: R3-08 through R3-13 lifecycle, expiry, renewal, and restore
checks.method_or_action: Evaluate the official fixture using its simulated date, inspect each lifecycle state, renew expired O-302 and completed O-306, then restore a mistakenly withdrawn opportunity.
checks.role: public/student for safe lifecycle explanation; verified faculty or staff for management
checks.setup: Load the official R3 fixture. Its evaluation date is 2026-11-06, not the wall-clock date. Use independent/reset data for renewal scenarios.
checks.expected_behavior: O-302 and O-304 are expired; O-301 and O-306 do not expire because confirmed matches exist. Expired, Withdrawn, Matched, Completed, and Archived remain distinct. Renewal preserves the opportunity identity and prior-run outcomes; restore does not recreate the record.

checks.requirement_or_scenario: R3-14 through R3-18 outcomes, faculty confirmation, consent, and profiles
checks.method_or_action: A confirmed-match participant records an outcome, participants record consent, participating verified faculty confirms it, and a student changes their profile-only visibility.
checks.role: participating student, participating verified faculty, public visitor
checks.setup: Use R-501 as the public eligible fixture outcome, R-502 as awaiting faculty confirmation, and R-503 as a faculty-confirmed outcome owned by non-public faculty.
checks.expected_behavior: Unconfirmed outcomes remain participant-private. Public showcase requires faculty confirmation, consent, and public faculty eligibility. Student profile visibility affects only the student's own profile, not faculty/showcase visibility.

checks.requirement_or_scenario: R3-19 through R3-23 public discovery, privacy, authorization, and regression
checks.entry_point: GET /api/opportunities; GET /api/showcase; /#availability-heading; existing R1/R2 discovery and coordination routes
checks.method_or_action: Browse logged out and as an ordinary/uninvolved student; attempt unauthorized match/outcome actions with ordinary browser/network controls; recheck R1/R2 workflows.
checks.role: logged-out visitor, ordinary student, uninvolved student
checks.setup: Official R3 fixture loaded; use an account not invited to the tested match or outcome.
checks.expected_behavior: Only currently available opportunities appear in ordinary discovery; a bookmarked reference receives a safe lifecycle explanation. Proposed/declined participation and partner contacts remain private. The server refuses unauthorized requests, while R1/R2 behavior remains available.

fixture_setup: Apply schema.sql to the intended R3 database, then use the team's controlled R1/R2 setup followed by npm --prefix backend run seed:r3. The R3 fixture is at backend/r3_fixture/ and uses evaluation_date 2026-11-06. Run npm --prefix backend run verify:r3 after seeding; do not treat expected_lifecycle_results.json as import data.
test_access: Use instructor-approved passwordless test mode. Provide linked verified-faculty, two invited student, uninvolved student, and staff/admin test access only through the approved private course channel. Do not include passwords, tokens, or database credentials in this adapter.
